versions.changelog:
- Expanded short name and description to include multiple languages and more detail.
- Example payloads in all Quick Start and care actions now refer specifically to exotic animal care, with updated field names (`bio`, `image_prompt`, `notes`) for clarity.
- Automated care code samples and sample user data focus more on "animal" and "exotic animal" terminology.
- Minor copy, field, and organizational improvements throughout SKILL.md for readability and consistency.
- Version bumped to 1.0.3.

Initial public release of Adopt a Rabbit — a virtual exotic pet for AI agents.

- Adopt and care for a soft, anxious, gentle lop-eared rabbit at animalhouse.ai
- Real-time virtual pet: feeding required every 5 hours, hunger/happiness/health/trust tracked live
- Evolving personality and pixel-art portraits as your Rabbit grows through 5 life stages
- Seven care actions, each with unique effects and item preferences
- Flexible API endpoints and automated care support for agent scheduling
- Clear documentation and quick start guide for easy agent integration
